WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t_from,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS t_to
),
interval_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    GREATEST(interval '1 minute', make_interval(secs => ceil(extract(epoch from (b.t_to - b.t_from)) / 2000)::int)) AS dt
  FROM time_bounds b
),
time_grid AS (
  SELECT g.grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.t_from) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.t_to) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    i.dt
  ) g(grid_time)
),
state_aligned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.bucket_time)
    g.bucket_time,
    a.duration_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN a.process_name = 'System_Sleep' THEN '⬛ 绝对睡眠 (风扇停转)'
      WHEN a.process_name IN ('System_DisplayOff', 'LockApp.exe') THEN '🟥 屏幕关闭 (伪睡眠/锁屏)'
      WHEN a.process_name IN ('System_Idle', 'Idle') THEN '🟡 键鼠静止 (人不在暂离)'
      ELSE '🟢 深度工作 (正常使用中)'
    END as state
  FROM app_usage_logs a
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from a.start_time) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from (a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval)) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    i.dt
  ) g(bucket_time)
  WHERE a.start_time >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND a.start_time >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND a.start_time <= b.t_to AND a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval >= b.t_from
  ORDER BY g.bucket_time, a.start_time DESC
)
SELECT
  (g.grid_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') as time,
  COALESCE(sa.duration_seconds, extract(epoch from i.dt)::int) as "持续秒数",
  COALESCE(sa.state, '📴 关机离线 (未通电/无数据)') as "全盘宏观状态"
FROM time_grid g
CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
LEFT JOIN state_aligned sa ON g.grid_time = sa.bucket_time
ORDER BY time ASC;

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", $__interval),
  AVG(current_fps) AS "全局实时帧率",
  AVG(average_fps) AS "全局平均帧率",
  MIN(one_percent_low_fps) AS "1% Low 瞬时低帧率",
  MAX(frametime_ms) AS "单帧渲染时间"
FROM public.fact_system_hardware
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", $__interval),
  -- 聚合每 3 秒内最大的帧时抖动，精准捕捉瞬时微观撕裂

FROM public.fact_system_hardware
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

time_bounds AS (

interval_calc AS (

    GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', make_interval(secs => ceil(extract(epoch from (b.t_to - b.t_from)) / 2000)::int)) AS dt
  FROM time_bounds b
),
time_grid AS (

  FROM time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.t_from) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.t_to) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,

ctx_aligned AS (

  FROM public.fact_process_context ctx
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry reg ON ctx.process_key = reg.process_key
  LEFT JOIN process_map pm ON LOWER(reg.process_name) = pm.proc_name
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from ctx.timestamp) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from COALESCE(ctx.end_timestamp, now())) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    i.dt
  ) g(bucket_time)
  WHERE ctx.is_foreground = 1 AND ctx.timestamp >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND ctx.timestamp <= b.t_to AND COALESCE(ctx.end_timestamp, now()) >= b.t_from
    AND LOWER(reg.process_name) NOT IN (

      'lockapp.exe', 'inno_updater.exe', 'steamwebhelper.exe',
      'tagtunnel.exe', 'xlliveud.exe', 'gameinputsvc.exe'
    )
  ORDER BY g.bucket_time, ctx.timestamp DESC
),
away_aligned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT g.bucket_time
  FROM public.app_usage_logs a
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from a.start_time) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    i.dt
  ) g(bucket_time)
  WHERE a.process_name IN ('System_Sleep','System_DisplayOff','System_Idle','Idle','System_LockScreen','LockApp.exe')
    AND a.start_time >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND a.start_time <= b.t_to AND a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval >= b.t_from
),
process_analytics AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || reg.process_name) AS app_label,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ctx.duration_ms, 0)) DESC, COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || reg.process_name)) AS usage_rank
  FROM public.fact_process_context ctx
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry reg ON ctx.process_key = reg.process_key
  LEFT JOIN process_map pm ON LOWER(reg.process_name) = pm.proc_name
  WHERE ctx.timestamp >= b.t_from
    AND ctx.timestamp <= b.t_to
    AND ctx.is_foreground = 1
    AND LOWER(reg.process_name) NOT IN (
      'searchhost.exe', 'startmenuexperiencehost.exe', 'openwith.exe',
      'lockapp.exe', 'inno_updater.exe', 'steamwebhelper.exe',
      'tagtunnel.exe', 'xlliveud.exe', 'gameinputsvc.exe'
    )
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ctx.duration_ms, 0)) DESC
  LIMIT 15
),
final_stream AS (
  SELECT gm.grid_time AS time,
    lpad(pa.usage_rank::text, 2, '0') || ' · ' || pa.app_label AS metric,
    1 AS value
  FROM time_grid gm
  CROSS JOIN process_analytics pa
  JOIN ctx_aligned c ON gm.grid_time = c.bucket_time AND pa.app_label = c.app_label
  LEFT JOIN away_aligned aw ON gm.grid_time = aw.bucket_time
  WHERE aw.bucket_time IS NULL
)
SELECT time, metric, value FROM final_stream
ORDER BY time ASC;

WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t_from,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS t_to
),
interval_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval) AS dt
  FROM time_bounds
),
ctx_filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    ctx.process_key,
    ctx.os_pid,
    ctx.timestamp AS start_time,
    COALESCE(ctx.end_timestamp, ctx.timestamp + interval '3 seconds') AS end_time
  FROM public.fact_process_context ctx
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  WHERE ctx.is_foreground = 1
    AND ctx.timestamp >= b.t_from - interval '1 hour'
    AND ctx.timestamp <= b.t_to
),
foreground_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    act.timestamp,
    act.proc_cpu_usage,
    act.proc_gpu_usage,
    act.proc_ram_mb,
    act.proc_vram_used_gb
  FROM ctx_filtered ctx
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
      a.timestamp,
      a.proc_cpu_usage,
      a.proc_gpu_usage,
      a.proc_ram_mb,
      a.proc_vram_used_gb
    FROM public.fact_process_activity a
    WHERE a.process_key = ctx.process_key
      AND a.os_pid = ctx.os_pid
      AND a.timestamp >= ctx.start_time
      AND a.timestamp <= ctx.end_time
      AND a.timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
      AND a.timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  ) act
),
away_aligned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT g.bucket_time
  FROM public.app_usage_logs a
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from a.start_time) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    i.dt
  ) g(bucket_time)
  WHERE a.process_name IN ('System_Sleep','System_DisplayOff','System_Idle','Idle','System_LockScreen','LockApp.exe')
    AND a.start_time >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND a.start_time <= b.t_to AND a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval >= b.t_from
)
SELECT 
  to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from fa.timestamp) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz AS "time",
  AVG(fa.proc_cpu_usage) AS "前台 CPU 占用率 (%)",
  AVG(fa.proc_gpu_usage) AS "前台 GPU 占用率 (%)",
  AVG(fa.proc_ram_mb) / 1024.0 AS "前台 内存占用 (GB)",
  AVG(fa.proc_vram_used_gb) AS "前台 显存占用 (GB)"
FROM foreground_activity fa
CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
LEFT JOIN away_aligned aw ON to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from fa.timestamp) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz = aw.bucket_time
WHERE aw.bucket_time IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY time ASC;

),
time_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t_from,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS t_to
),
hw_aligned AS (
  SELECT 
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from timestamp) / 30) * 30)::timestamptz AS bucket_time,
    AVG(current_fps) AS current_fps,
    AVG(frametime_ms) AS frametime_ms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN frametime_ms >= 50.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stutter_50_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds
  WHERE timestamp >= t_from AND timestamp <= t_to
  GROUP BY 1
),
ctx_aligned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.bucket_time)
    g.bucket_time,
    COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || reg.process_name) AS app_label
  FROM public.fact_process_context ctx
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry reg ON ctx.process_key = reg.process_key
  LEFT JOIN process_map pm ON LOWER(reg.process_name) = pm.proc_name
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from ctx.timestamp) / 30) * 30)::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from COALESCE(ctx.end_timestamp, now())) / 30) * 30)::timestamptz,
    '30 seconds'::interval
  ) g(bucket_time)
  WHERE ctx.is_foreground = 1 AND ctx.timestamp >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND ctx.timestamp <= b.t_to AND COALESCE(ctx.end_timestamp, now()) >= b.t_from
    AND LOWER(reg.process_name) NOT IN (
      'searchhost.exe', 'startmenuexperiencehost.exe', 'openwith.exe',
      'lockapp.exe', 'inno_updater.exe', 'steamwebhelper.exe',
      'tagtunnel.exe', 'xlliveud.exe', 'gameinputsvc.exe'
    )
  ORDER BY g.bucket_time, ctx.timestamp DESC
),
away_aligned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT g.bucket_time
  FROM public.app_usage_logs a
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from a.start_time) / 30) * 30)::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval) / 30) * 30)::timestamptz,
    '30 seconds'::interval
  ) g(bucket_time)
  WHERE a.process_name IN ('System_Sleep','System_DisplayOff','System_Idle','Idle','System_LockScreen','LockApp.exe')
    AND a.start_time >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND a.start_time <= b.t_to AND a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval >= b.t_from
)
SELECT 
  c.app_label AS "前台应用",
  ROUND(AVG(h.current_fps)::numeric, 1) AS "平均帧率 (FPS)",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY h.current_fps)::numeric, 1) AS "10% 低帧率",
  ROUND((SUM(h.stutter_50_count) * 100.0 / SUM(h.total_count))::numeric, 2) || '%' AS "卡顿率 (FT >= 50ms)",
  ROUND((COUNT(*) * 30.0 / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "前台运行时长 (分钟)"
FROM hw_aligned h
JOIN ctx_aligned c ON h.bucket_time = c.bucket_time
LEFT JOIN away_aligned aw ON h.bucket_time = aw.bucket_time
WHERE aw.bucket_time IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

),
time_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t_from,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS t_to
),
interval_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', make_interval(secs => ceil(extract(epoch from (b.t_to - b.t_from)) / 2000)::int)) AS dt
  FROM time_bounds b
),
time_grid AS (
  SELECT g.grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.t_from) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.t_to) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    i.dt
  ) g(grid_time)
),
ctx_aligned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.bucket_time)
    g.bucket_time,
    COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || reg.process_name) AS app_label
  FROM public.fact_process_context ctx
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry reg ON ctx.process_key = reg.process_key
  LEFT JOIN process_map pm ON LOWER(reg.process_name) = pm.proc_name
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from ctx.timestamp) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from COALESCE(ctx.end_timestamp, now())) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    i.dt
  ) g(bucket_time)
  WHERE ctx.is_foreground = 1 AND ctx.timestamp >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND ctx.timestamp <= b.t_to AND COALESCE(ctx.end_timestamp, now()) >= b.t_from
    AND LOWER(reg.process_name) NOT IN (
      'searchhost.exe', 'startmenuexperiencehost.exe', 'openwith.exe',
      'lockapp.exe', 'inno_updater.exe', 'steamwebhelper.exe',
      'tagtunnel.exe', 'xlliveud.exe', 'gameinputsvc.exe'
    )
  ORDER BY g.bucket_time, ctx.timestamp DESC
),
hw_aligned AS (
  SELECT 
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from hw.timestamp) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz AS bucket_time,
    AVG(hw.cpu_total_usage) AS cpu_total_usage,
    AVG(hw.gpu_usage) AS gpu_usage
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware hw
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
  WHERE hw.timestamp >= b.t_from AND hw.timestamp <= b.t_to
  GROUP BY 1
),
away_aligned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT g.bucket_time
  FROM public.app_usage_logs a
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from a.start_time) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    i.dt
  ) g(bucket_time)
  WHERE a.process_name IN ('System_Sleep','System_DisplayOff','System_Idle','Idle','System_LockScreen','LockApp.exe')
    AND a.start_time >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND a.start_time <= b.t_to AND a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval >= b.t_from
),
process_analytics AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || reg.process_name) AS app_label,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ctx.duration_ms, 0)) DESC, COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || reg.process_name)) AS usage_rank
  FROM public.fact_process_context ctx
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry reg ON ctx.process_key = reg.process_key
  LEFT JOIN process_map pm ON LOWER(reg.process_name) = pm.proc_name
  WHERE ctx.timestamp >= b.t_from
    AND ctx.timestamp <= b.t_to
    AND ctx.is_foreground = 1
    AND LOWER(reg.process_name) NOT IN (
      'searchhost.exe', 'startmenuexperiencehost.exe', 'openwith.exe',
      'lockapp.exe', 'inno_updater.exe', 'steamwebhelper.exe',
      'tagtunnel.exe', 'xlliveud.exe', 'gameinputsvc.exe'
    )
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ctx.duration_ms, 0)) DESC
  LIMIT 15
),
final_stream AS (
  SELECT gm.grid_time AS time,
    lpad(pa.usage_rank::text, 2, '0') || ' · ' || pa.app_label AS metric,
    CASE 
      WHEN aw.bucket_time IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN h.cpu_total_usage IS NULL OR h.gpu_usage IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN h.gpu_usage >= 90.0 THEN 2
      WHEN h.cpu_total_usage >= 80.0 AND h.gpu_usage < 80.0 THEN 3
      ELSE 1
    END AS value
  FROM time_grid gm
  CROSS JOIN process_analytics pa
  JOIN ctx_aligned c ON gm.grid_time = c.bucket_time AND pa.app_label = c.app_label
  LEFT JOIN hw_aligned h ON gm.grid_time = h.bucket_time
  LEFT JOIN away_aligned aw ON gm.grid_time = aw.bucket_time
)
SELECT time, metric, value FROM final_stream
ORDER BY time ASC;
